task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Solve MaxCut with QAOA (p=1) in Cirq for the graph [(0, 2), (0, 4), (1, 2), (2, 3)]: scan a grid of (gamma, beta) values, pick the best, sample the circuit and report the best cut. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
